gloss: leadership; ability to command a group

definitions.gloss: leadership; ability to lead and control a group
definitions.explanation: The ability to bring a team, army or organization together under one's command and make it act as a unit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{統率力|とうそつりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われている→問う：02299_tou⟧。
examples.english: The manager's ability to lead the team is being questioned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{統率力|とうそつりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れ→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧、⟦ばらばら→ばらばら：05165_barabara⟧だった⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: The new captain is a strong leader and pulled a scattered team together.

notes:
